steps.message:
1. Which file do those line numbers come from, and what are the names of the function that fills the prefetch store and the function that takes from it? I need the actual function bodies, not just the line numbers shown on the screen.

2. What is the exact data layout of the prefetch store, in particular what the "end" field is supposed to point to and what invariant connects it to the block size? Is the end supposed to be the first byte after the block, the last byte of the block, or something else?

3. Is there any unmodified copy of this tree left anywhere that I could diff against, since there is no git history to show what was changed? If not, do you have the original patch or a written list of the modifications that were made to the sweeping code?

4. Does the crash occur every time on the same make target, and if you run that target in a debugger is the bad value in the store always a null pointer or does it vary from run to run? That will tell me whether the store is being left empty or is being written with the wrong address.

5. Have you yet checked the point at which the store is supposed to be primed, to make sure that the filling pass actually runs before the first take? It would also be useful to know the values of the size and offset variables at the moment the first bad take is attempted.

6. What exactly was meant by the attempted correction to the part that finds the next item in the store, since the description of it as being in the contrary of the proper state does not say what the code now does?
